rows.property: After every one of 250 seeded-random edits to a 4-slot interprocedural module, memoised compiler_check_diagnostics (checks and optimisations) equals compiler_check_diagnostics_uncached.
rows.cost_driver: 250 iterations x (incremental recompute + full uncached build) of a <=4-procedure document. This is a seeded-random edit storm: rule 1 of the tier contract says it belongs in the exhaustive tier.
rows.recommendation: Deep and light (new deterministic test): a fixed edit script that visits every variant of every slot from the base state and the cascade edges (pass x caller: passthrough<->constant<->arity-2 under the tainted caller; leaf global<->pure under benign caller; calc variants) — about 30 edits. Memoise `want` per state string. Light = the 8 cascade-edge edits. Original seeded storm: either (a) #[ignore = "seeded edit storm; run explicitly with --ignored"] per contract rule 1 (moves its assertions to exhaustive; needs sign-off, because they would no longer run before a PR), or (b) keep it in deep with `want` memoised by state (identical assertions; <=144 distinct states).
